Home.title: Every rescue animal deserves the right home
Home.lead: Homeward connects rescue organisations with people looking to adopt, with clear information about which animals suit which homes.
Home.adopterBody: Tell us about your home and household, privately. We show you at a glance which animals are a strong match, which might work, and why.
Home.orgBody: Get animals online quickly with structured details, photos and adoption criteria. Your listings live in your own account on the Atmosphere.

Discover.title: Find an animal
Discover.comingSoon: Search and filters are on their way.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.intro: Sign in with your Bluesky or Eurosky account, using an app password.
SignIn.passwordHint: It looks like xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx. Create one in your account settings. Never use your main password.
SignIn.appPasswordHelp: How to create an app password
SignIn.success: Signed in as @{handle}. Homeward doesn't keep sessions yet, so you've been signed out again.

errors.invalidIdentifier: Enter your handle, for example yourname.eurosky.social.
errors.handleNotFound: We couldn't find that handle. Check the spelling and try again.
errors.noPds: We couldn't find a server for this account.
errors.invalidCredentials: That app password doesn't match this account. Check it, or create a new one.
errors.fullAccessPassword: That looks like your main account password. For your safety, Homeward only accepts app passwords, and we've ended that sign-in. Create an app password in your account settings and use that instead.
errors.accountUnavailable: This account has been suspended or deactivated on its server.
errors.serverUnreachable: We couldn't reach your account's server. Please try again in a moment.
